hero.title: Don't know where to go? The walk finds itself
hero.subtitle: Tell it how much time you have and what mood you are in — get a ready-made walking route through real streets, with meaningful stops and honest timing.

features.title: Why it works
features.subtitle: A walk generator, not a nearest-place connector

smartRouting.title: Loops on real streets
smartRouting.description: A server-side engine builds the route: pedestrian distance matrix, stop reordering, loop closure and quality gates — budget ±10%, no leg too long

categories.title: Anchors with reasons
categories.description: Every stop is a specific place with a reason to visit, how long to stay, and whether it is open right now. Not "a cafe category" but "Coffee Shop X — top rated"

transport.title: Weather and time of day
transport.description: Rain — indoor places first, heat — shade and greenery, evening — lit and lively streets. The walk adapts to context instead of ignoring it

sharing.title: Link = walk
sharing.description: Send a link to a friend — they open the same walk, each in their own language. Plus a "Go" button hands the route straight to Yandex Maps

history.title: One-tap swaps
history.description: Don't like the cafe — swap it. Don't like the courtyard — rebuild. A segment changes, not the whole walk. Like it — save to history

alternatives.title: Alternatives with zero waiting
alternatives.description: The engine prepares several walk variants at once — switch between them instantly, no rebuild required

tutorial.title: How it works
tutorial.subtitle: From "nothing to do" to a walk in three steps

step1.title: Pick your time
step1.description: 30 minutes, an hour or ninety — the time budget sets the radius and the number of stops. Everything fits your range within ±10%

step2.title: Pick your vibe
step2.description: Green parks, a coffee quest, a quiet evening, a rainy indoor option, or "surprise me"

step3.title: Get your walk
step3.description: A loop on real streets from your location, with anchor stops, reasons and a timeline. Dislike a stop — swap it, the route rebuilds locally

step4.title: Walk and share
step4.description: Save the walk to history or send a friend the link — it opens in their language. The "Go" button hands the route to Yandex Maps

step5.title: Choose from Multiple Options
step5.description: For each route point, the app suggests several places. Swipe the carousel and choose what suits you better — the route will recalculate automatically

step6.title: Share with Friends and Save
step6.description: Click 'Share' button to copy the link — friends will see your route on the map. Sign in and click the bookmark to save the route to history

cta.title: Got a free hour?
cta.subtitle: Pick time and vibe — the walk assembles in seconds. An account is only needed to save walks to history.

Footer.description: Plan smart routes with interesting places. Cafes, parks, museums — everything on your way.
